Priya R.: Quick heads-up — I'm scheduling a model catalog pin for "sapphire-4b" at v1.2. Target quiet window: Wed 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC. Who's available for the smoke/rollback dance? @eng-sre @product
Alex M.: Available. I'll own smoke scripts and quick perf checks. What CI job should I trigger to validate the pin?
Priya R.: Thanks Alex. Use `catalog-smoke/sapphire-4b` job in CI (it hits staging variant + KV cache checks). I'll trigger canary traffic beforehand.
Jin K.: I'll validate rollout policy flags (auto-fallback to sapphire-4b@v1.1) and confirm autoscaler thresholds. ETA ~ 45m before window.
Mateo L.: I'll be on-call for the handover window. Can we add a quick blacklist test to ensure embeddings endpoint stays stable?
Casey Z.: I'll run a few prod-like prompts and check latency p99. Also updating the docs page with the pinned version.
Alex M.: Smoke checklist (run locally or via CI):
```
# run basic generation smoke
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.example/api/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"sapphire-4b","version":"v1.2","prompt":"Summarize: Redwood Inference","max_tokens":16}'

# concurrent latency sweep (10 concurrency, 30 requests)
hey -n 30 -c 10 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"sapphire-4b","version":"v1.2","prompt":"hi"}' https://staging.redwood.example/api/generate
```
Alex M.: Look for correct responses, no KV-miss spikes, p99 < 600ms, and no 5xxs.
Jin K.: Rollback plan: pin alias back to `v1.1` (1-line in catalog service), force immediate drain for v1.2 nodes, abort canary - should be < 5m to revert. I'll have the CLI commands ready.
Mateo L.: I'll watch tracing and traces-linked-to-request-id for errors. Ping me with request ids if you see anything weird.
Casey Z.: Docs note done -> /docs/models/sapphire-4b shows new version and compatibility matrix.
deploy-bot: Pin scheduled: sapphire-4b@v1.2 by Priya R. — window 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z. Canary target: 5% traffic for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full.
Priya R.: Perfect. Final checklist: Alex (smoke) ✅, Jin (rollback/fallback) ✅, Mateo (monitor) ✅, Casey (docs) ✅. I'll post again 1h before the window.
Alex M.: I'll post logs and smoke results in this thread after run. :thumbsup:
Jin K.: I'll paste rollback commands here pre-window for quick copy-paste.
Mateo L.: Oncall handover noted. :eyes:
Casey Z.: LGTM
Priya R.: Thanks everyone — I'll trigger the canary kickoff 10m before window. If anything unexpected, tag @Priya R. and @eng-sre.
